name: @meffmadd/bash-deny
description: Gitignore-like shell command blocklist for CI, pre-commit hooks, and interactive use.

scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/scenarios/*.test.ts tests/cli/*.test.ts tests/parser/*.test.ts
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: esbuild bash-deny/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/bash-deny.js && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bash-deny.js', 0o755)"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
